scripts.typecheck: pnpm build && pnpm -r --if-present typecheck && tsc -p tests/tsconfig.json
scripts.clean: node -e "import('node:fs').then(async ({rmSync, readdirSync, existsSync}) => { const dirs = ['apps', 'packages', 'services']; for (const root of dirs) { if (!existsSync(root)) continue; for (const entry of readdirSync(root)) { for (const target of ['dist', 'coverage', 'tsconfig.tsbuildinfo', 'tsconfig.build.tsbuildinfo']) { rmSync(root + '/' + entry + '/' + target, { recursive: true, force: true }); } } } rmSync('coverage', { recursive: true, force: true }); })"
